# Storyboard — product promo

> **Template.** Align with `hyperframes-core/references/storyboard-format.md`. One primary message per beat.

## Project

- **Title:**
- **Duration target:** 30–60s (adjust with receipt)
- **Aspect:** 16:9 · 1920×1080 · 30fps
- **Density default:** Level 3 (Acts 1–2), Level 0–1 (Act 3 CTA)

## Beat map

| Beat | Time (s) | Act | Primary message | Visual | Motion / seam | Audio |
| ---- | -------- | --- | --------------- | ------ | ------------- | ----- |
| 1 | 0–5 | Problem | | Kinetic headline, dark stage | Type scale-in | VO / SFX |
| 2 | 5–10 | Problem→Proof | | Object metaphor or pain UI | Whip or morph → | |
| 3 | 10–20 | Proof | | Feature / UI surface 1 | Panel reveal | |
| 4 | 20–28 | Proof | | Benefit 2–3 (rule of three) | Color flip or cut | |
| 5 | 28–35 | CTA | | Logo + tagline + URL | **Hold still** | Music resolve |

Add/remove rows; keep **one idea per beat**.
